en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.941 - It has been narrated that "crying over a deceased person interrupts the prayer, but crying out of remembrance for Paradise and Hellfire is among the best deeds during prayer."

It is also narrated that "there is a measure or weight for everything except for tears shed out of the fear of Allah (swt), as a single drop of it can extinguish vast fires of Hell. And if a person who cries were present among a nation, they would be blessed with mercy."
